tabs.name: Branch (Pickup methods)
tabs.subtitle: Only for Pickup methods: link the branch this method represents. The link is what puts the branch name on kitchen tickets — the method's own name is what the customer reads at checkout.

elements.label: Outlet
elements.hint: The chosen branch's id travels onto every order that selects this method (as the outlet_id checkout field), so the Kitchen Queue and tickets keep saying which branch is cooking.
